title: Enforce permissions when reviewing orphaned extension data
summary: Permission checks now consistently apply when marking orphaned extension data as reviewed through both notification and page actions.
key_points: Added CheckPermissions() call to notification action for marking data as reviewed
Refactored shared implementation between notification and page entry points
Stricter permission enforcement on page open
No behavioral changes for users with proper permissions
quote: Ensure marking orphaned extension data as reviewed consistently calls CheckPermissions() from both the notification and page actions.
